mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationSelAgent*/ SELECT AGENT_CODE, AGENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT HD.PO_NO) AS PO_CNT, SUM(AGENT_PRICE) AS TOT_AMT FROM ( SELECT COM_CODE AS AGENT_CODE, COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_name}||'%' ) A, ICOMPOHD HD, ICOMPODT DT WHERE HD.AGENT = AGENT_CODE AND HD.ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND HD.STATUS <> 'D' AND DT.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND DT.PO_NO = HD.PO_NO AND DT.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY AGENT_CODE,AGENT_NAME ORDER BY TOT_AMT DESC, PO_CNT DESC

/*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationSelAgent*/ SELECT AGENT_CODE, AGENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT HD.PO_NO) AS PO_CNT, SUM(AGENT_PRICE) AS TOT_AMT, #{st_search_code} AS SEARCH_CODE FROM ( SELECT COM_CODE AS AGENT_CODE, COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE IN ( SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'MYAGENT' AND BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE1 = #{st_search_code} AND ADD_USER_ID = #{USER_ID} ) ) A, ICOMPOHD HD, ICOMPODT DT WHERE HD.AGENT = AGENT_CODE AND HD.ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND HD.STATUS <> 'D' AND DT.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND DT.PO_NO = HD.PO_NO AND DT.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY AGENT_CODE,AGENT_NAME ORDER BY TOT_AMT DESC, PO_CNT DESC
mapper.update: /*insertMasterMpRqBulkQuotationSelAgentRfq*/ INSERT INTO KEP_BURQ_RFQ ( BURQ_NO,ITEM_KEY_ID,AGENT,AGENT_TYPE,BYIT_COMORG_CODE,BUYER,BURQ_RFQ_NO,STATUS,GPL_YN,ATOS_END_DATE, KEP_DESCRIPTION,KEP_SPECIFICATION,KEP_MAKER_PART_NO,KEP_MAKER_CODE,KEP_MIN_ORDER_QTY,KEP_PUR_UNIT_QTY,KEP_UNIT_MEASURE, SM_DESCRIPTION, SM_SPECIFICATION, SM_MAKER_PART_NO, SM_MAKER_CODE, SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY, SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY, SM_UNIT_MEASURE, SM_PROCESS_TYPE, SM_PARCEL_YN, SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE, DELIVERY_LT, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID )( SELECT A.BURQ_NO, ITEM_KEY_ID, #{AGENT_CODE} AS AGENT, 'A' AS AGENT_TYPE, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, BUYER, BURQ_RFQ_NO, 'K3' AS STATUS, GPL_YN, ATOS_END_DATE, KEP_DESCRIPTION, KEP_SPECIFICATION, KEP_MAKER_PART_NO, KEP_MAKER_CODE, KEP_MIN_ORDER_QTY, KEP_PUR_UNIT_QTY, KEP_UNIT_MEASURE, SM_DESCRIPTION, SM_SPECIFICATION, SM_MAKER_PART_NO, SM_MAKER_CODE, SM_MIN_ORDER_QTY, SM_PUR_UNIT_QTY, SM_UNIT_MEASURE, SM_PROCESS_TYPE, SM_PARCEL_YN, SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE, DELIVERY_LT, SYSDATE AS ADD_DATE, #{USER_ID} AS ADD_USER_ID FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ A WHERE A.BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} AND A.ITEM_KEY_ID = #{ITEM_KEY_ID} AND A.AGENT_TYPE = 'B' )
